analysis_status: post-outcome descriptive analysis of saved fixed-input results
primary_population: Existing comparable QA only; all selected QA and exclusions retained separately

definitions.order_membership: Canonical inputs/* trial_plan.order_group, after duplicate permutation omission; original is counted once and repeat_2..5 are excluded
definitions.decision_change_same_binary_quality: At least two order decisions differ, every selected Y is known binary, and all selected Y values agree
definitions.decision_change_quality_changes: At least two order decisions differ, every selected Y is known binary, and both 0 and 1 occur
definitions.decision_change_quality_unknown: At least two order decisions differ and any selected Y is unknown; this category takes priority even if known 0 and 1 also occur
definitions.no_decision_change: All valid order decisions agree; unknown selected quality is retained in a separate field
definitions.failed_rewrite: Use the actual selected A and its annotation when a failed requested rewrite falls back; do not infer B or an improvement/harm
definitions.costs: Per-QA min/max across valid unique observed order routes of recorded calls and known input+output tokens; not confidence bounds or total collection/annotation cost. Missing amounts and incomplete/unknown outcome flags are retained
definitions.quality: Saved external AI labels; not newly graded human truth. A change can be either improvement or degradation depending on which order is used

non_authoritative_export_flags.note: Exported trial group booleans disagree with canonical trial_plan membership. They are audited but never used to select orders; frozen material is unchanged
